f4_geometry.derivation: from c=b2+b3 (LIN_013) or c=b3-b2 (LIN_019), the four surface quadrics give b2*b3=minus_or_plus_a1^2/2; squaring and substituting b2^2=a1^2+a3^2, b3^2=a1^2+a2^2 gives the same F4 equation

rows.sign_orbit_norm_method: multiply by q-sign conjugate, then y-sign conjugate, then r-sign conjugate in the 8-dimensional square-root algebra
rows.square_implication_used: if the residue were a square in the strict-prime function field then the product of all sign conjugates would be a square in Q(i)(x); therefore a nonsquare sign-orbit product certifies a nonsquare residue
